y-m-71-04.title: Uma sihlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-a, b = c?
y-m-71-04.goal: Khombisa ngesibonelo esiphikisayo ukuthi ama-dot product alinganayo akwenzi ama-vector amabili alingane, bese usebenza ukuthi asala amangaki uma kwengezwa umbandela wosayizi.
y-m-71-04.material: Ama-vector endiza angu-a = (2, 1) no-c = (1, 3). UJisu uthe, 'Njengoba a · b = a · c, ukuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-a kunika b = c.' (Ichashaza leli elincane lisho i-dot product.) b unesimo b = (b1, b2) futhi izingxenye zalo ziyizinombolo zangempela.
y-m-71-04.thinking.0: Ukuhlola ukuthi imithetho yokubala ngezinombolo ingathwalwa ngqo iyiswe ku-dot product yama-vector
y-m-71-04.thinking.2: Ukucabanga ngenani lezixazululo uma kwengezwa umbandela
y-m-71-04.prereq.0: Umcabango: lo msebenzi usethwe ezingeni eliphakeme lesikole esiphakeme, ukuxazululwa ngemva kokufunda inkambo yokukhetha 'Geometry' (ama-conic sections, ama-vector endiza, izinto eziqinile nokuqondanisa komkhathi); 'H3' iwuphawu lobunzima kuphela kwalesi sabelo sokukhiqiza futhi ayisho ukuthi inkambo yabelwe ebangeni elithile. Isimo sengxenye yama-vector endiza, ukubala i-dot product ngezingxenye, usayizi we-vector
y-m-71-04.s.s1.prompt: Iyiphi indlela eqinisekile kakhulu yokuhlola ukuthi isiphetho sikaJisu 'b = c' sihlala sigcina?
y-m-71-04.s.s1.hint.0: Xazulula a · b = a · c ngezingxenye bese ukubhala njengesibalo phakathi kuka-b1 no-b2.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha b eyodwa enelisa lesosibalo bese uyiqhathanisa no-c.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.a: Faka b eziningi bese ubona ukuthi zonke zingu-b = c yini
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.a: Ukuqoqa izibonelo nokubheka kuphela lezo ezihambisanayo akukwazi ukukhombisa 'njalo'. Ikakhulukazi, izibonelo ozikhethayo zingathambekela ohlangothini olulodwa.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.b: Hlola ukuthi njengoba a ingeyona i-zero vector, singahlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.b: Uthwale umthetho wokukhansela osetshenziswa ekuphindaphindeni izinombolo ngqo waya ku-dot product. I-dot product yindlela yokusebenza eguqula ama-vector abe yinombolo.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.c: Funa b ene-a · b = a · c futhi b ≠ c
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.c: Usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi ukuphula 'njalo', isibonelo esisodwa esinelisa umbandela kodwa esinesiphetho esingalungile sanele.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.o.d: Qala ngokuqhathanisa ukuthi b no-c banosayizi ofanayo yini
y-m-71-04.s.s1.r.d: Ukuba nosayizi ofanayo kungumbandela odingekayo ku-b = c, kodwa kufanele uqale uhlole ukuthi kulandela kumbandela onikeziwe yini.
y-m-71-04.s.s1.explain: Ukuphula 'ihlala igcina', isibonelo esisodwa esinelisa umbandela a · b = a · c kuyilapho b ≠ c sanele.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.prompt: Faka ama-b = (b1, b2) ama-3 ahlukene anezingxenye eziyizinombolo eziphelele anelisa a · b = a · c kodwa b ≠ c. (|b1| ≤ 5)
y-m-71-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubala inani lika-a · c ngokufaka u-c, bese ubhala a · b ngezingxenye bese uzimisa zilingane.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha b1 bese uhlola ukuthi b2 inqunywa kanjani, bese uhlola ukuthi b ihlukile ku-c.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.fail.c2: b ifana no-c. Thola i-vector ehlukile.
y-m-71-04.s.s2.explain: a · c = 2·1 + 1·3 = 5, ngakho kwanele ukuthi 2b1 + b2 = 5. Zikhona eziningi ngokuthanda kwakho, njenge-(0, 5), (2, 1), (3, −1). Zonke lezi b zinengxenye efanayo ngesiqondiso sika-a no-c futhi zihluka kuphela engxenyeni eqondene no-a.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.prompt: Uma wengeza futhi |b| = |c| (usayizi ka-b ulingana nosayizi ka-c), mangaki ama-b akhona sewonke ane-a · b = a · c no-b ≠ c? (Izingxenye ziyizinombolo zangempela.)
y-m-71-04.s.s3.hint.0: Faka b2 = 5 − 2b1 ku-b1² + b2² = 10 ukwenza isisho ku-b1.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi u-c ngokwakhe ungaphakathi kwezixazululo ezitholiwe yini bese umkhipha.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.a: Ucabange ukuthi b = c ukuphela kwayo. Xazulula izibalo ezimbili ndawonye bese ubala ukuthi mangaki amanani ka-b1 aphumayo.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.b: Uqaphele ukuthi imibandela emibili cishe inquma b. Uma uxazulula ngqo, kusala enye eyodwa ngaphandle kuka-b = c.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.c: Uyifanise nezixazululo ezi-2 zezibalo ezimbili. Ingabe uhlolile ukuthi enye yazo iyi-c ngokwayo?
y-m-71-04.s.s3.r.d: Uthwale isiphetho sesimo lapho kunombandela owodwa. Njengoba kukhona isibalo esisodwa esengeziwe, sebenza ukuthi izixazululo zishintsha kanjani.
y-m-71-04.s.s3.explain: Ukuhlanganisa 2b1 + b2 = 5 no-b1² + b2² = 10 kunika (1, 3) no-(3, −1). (1, 3) kuyi-c ngokwayo, ngakho b kuphela ehlukile ku-c ngu-(3, −1). Le b yi-vector c ebonisiwe ngaphesheya kwelayini lesiqondiso sika-a.

y-m-71-08.title: Kuya ngendawo yephoyinti, mangaki ama-tangent angadwetshwa?
y-m-71-08.goal: Bikezela futhi uguqule inani lama-tangent angadwetshwa avela ephoyintini elingaphandle, elisephabolweni, nelingaphakathi kwe-parabola u-y² = 4x, bese uchaza ukuthi yiliphi i-tangent isixazululo esithatha ukuthambeka njengonhlamvu esiyiphosayo.
y-m-71-08.material: Cabanga nge-parabola u-y² = 4x (y squared equals four x). I-vertex ngu-O(0, 0). Sifuna ukuthola ukuthi mangaki imigqa ye-tangent engadwetshwa kule parabola ivela ephoyintini u-A endizeni yezixhumanisi. Uma iphoyinti liku-parabola, sibala umugqa we-tangent odlula kuleli phoyinti. Ubude abunazinyunithi.
y-m-71-08.thinking.1: Ukuguqula isahlulelo sakho uma kuvela iphoyinti elisha
y-m-71-08.prereq.0: Ukucabanga: lo msebenzi usethwe ebangeni eliphezulu lesikole esiphakeme, ukuze uxazululwe ngemuva kokufunda kakade isifundo esikhethwayo se-'Geometry' (izingxenye zekhoni, ama-vector asendizeni, izinto eziqinile nezixhumanisi zendawo); u-'H3' ulebula nje yobunzima kule batch yokukhiqiza futhi akusho ukuthi isifundo sabelwe ibanga elithile. Uhlobo oluvamile lwe-parabola, i-equation ye-tangent (i-tangent enokuthambeka u-m inefomu u-y = mx + 1/m), i-discriminant ye-quadratic equation
y-m-71-08.s.s1.prompt: Amaphoyinti ayambulwa elilodwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, bikezela inani lama-tangent angadwetshwa avela kuleli phoyinti.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.hint.0: Faka izixhumanisi zephoyinti ku-y² = 4x bese uqhathanisa ukuthi yimuphi omkhulu phakathi kuka-y² no-4x.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala i-tangent enokuthambeka u-m njengo-y = mx + 1/m, faka izixhumanisi zephoyinti ukwenza i-equation ku-m, bese uhlola uphawu lwe-discriminant.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mangaki ama-tangent angadwetshwa asuka ku-A aya ku-parabola?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.after: I-tangent u-y = mx + 1/m edlula ku-A(1, 3) inelisa u-3 = m + 1/m, okungukuthi, u-m² − 3m + 1 = 0, i-discriminant yayo ingu-5, iphozithivu, ngakho kunokuthambeka okungu-2. Iphoyinti liphezulu, ngakho kunama-tangent angu-2.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wacabanga ukuthi kunetangent eyodwa kuphela. Hlola ukuthi ungathola yini ukuthambeka okungu-2 okuhlukile kwama-tangent adlula ephoyintini.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Awuhlukanisanga ukuthi iphoyinti liphandle noma ngaphakathi kwe-parabola. Cabanga ukuthi ama-tangent angadwetshwa evela kuliphi icala.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Inkumbulo yokuthi kunama-tangent amabili asuka ephoyintini langaphandle nokuqhathaniswa kwendawo yephoyinti kuyahambisana.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.after: I-tangent edlula ku-B(1, 2) inelisa u-2 = m + 1/m, okungukuthi, u-(m − 1)² = 0, ngakho kunokuthambeka okukodwa kuphela (m = 1). Ephoyintini eliku-parabola kunetangent engu-1.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uhlulele ukuthi ephoyintini eliku-parabola kukhona kuphela i-tangent ephoyintini lelo.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uthwale isiphetho seliphoyinti elingaphandle. Leli phoyinti lise-parabola, ngakho indawo ishintshile.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kusukela eliphoyinteni elise-parabola kukhona umugqa othintayo kuleliphoyinti. Hlola ukuthi kukhona yini umugqa othintayo odlula eliphoyinteni.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mingaki imigqa ethintayo engadwetshwa kusukela ku-C?
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.after: Umugqa othintayo odlula ku-C(4, 1) ufeza 1 = 4m + 1/m, okungukuthi, 4m² − m + 1 = 0, futhi i-discriminant ingu-1 − 16 < 0, ngakho akukho kuthambeka. Kusukela eliphoyinteni elingaphakathi, akukho mugqa othintayo ongadwetshwa.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uthwale isiphetho seliphoyinti elise-parabola. Leli phoyinti aliyona ku-parabola.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uhlulele ukuthi liphoyinti elingaphakathi kwe-parabola, ngakho akukho imigqa ethintayo nhlobo.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uthwale isiphetho seliphoyinti elingaphandle. Qhathanisa osayizi be-4x no-y² ukuhlola ukuthi liphakathi yini.
y-m-71-08.s.s1.reflect: Amanani emigqa ethintayo emaphoyinteni amathathu ayengu-2, 1 no-0. Ungasho kanjani indawo yephoyinti ngokuqhathanisa osayizi be-y² no-4x? Cabanga nokuthi lokhu kuqhathanisa kuxhumana kanjani nophawu lwe-discriminant.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.prompt: Zingaki imigqa ethintayo ezingadwetshwa ku-parabola kusukela eliphoyinteni D(0, 3)? Thola futhi ubhale yonke imigqa ethintayo, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi lokhu kuyavumelana nomphumela wesixazululo esimisa ukuthambeka njengo-m.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi isibalo a·m² − b·m + 1 = 0 ku-m sishintsha kanjani uma i-x-coordinate ye-D ingu-0.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.hint.1: Bala ukuthi mingaki imigqa ethintayo oyithole kusukela esibalweni ku-m, bese udweba imigqa edlula iphoyinti D ngeziqondiso ezahlukahlukene ubone ukuthi ikhona yini eminye imigqa ehlangana ne-parabola endaweni eyodwa kuphela.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngichaze ngamazwi ami ukuthi isibalo sishintsha kanjani esixazululweni esimisa ukuthambeka njengo-m?
y-m-71-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngehlukanise umugqa othintayo onokuthambeka nomugqa othintayo okungenakusetshenziswa ukuthambeka kwawo?
y-m-71-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ngihlolile ukuthi imigqa ethintayo engiyibhalile idlula ngempela ku-D(0, 3)?
y-m-71-08.s.s2.model.0: 2. Ukufaka (0, 3) ku-y = mx + 1/m kunika 3 = 1/m, ngakho kuphuma kuphela umugqa othintayo owodwa y = x/3 + 3 onokuthambeka okungu-1/3, kodwa i-y-axis (x = 0), engenakuthambeka, nayo iyumugqa othintayo ku-vertex, ngakho sekunye kuyi-2.
y-m-71-08.s.s2.model.1: Kunemigqa emibili ethintayo. Lokhu kungenzeka ngoba iphoyinti D liphandle kwe-parabola, futhi owodwa ngu-x = 0 nomunye ngu-y = (1/3)x + 3. x = 0 ayikwazi ukubhalwa ngefomu y = mx + n, ngakho iyaphuthelwa yisixazululo esisebenzisa ukuthambeka.

y-m-71-01.title: Ingabe kunephoyinti elilodwa kuphela ebangeni elingu-10 kusuka ku-focus?
y-m-71-01.goal: Esixazululweni esithola amaphoyinti usebenzisa isimo sebanga eliphuma endaweni ku-parabola liya ku-focus, thola umugqa owashiya i-symmetry, bese wenza wena ukuthi mangaki amaphoyinti anelisa isimo sonke.
y-m-71-01.material: Cabanga nge-parabola y² = 8x (ifundwa: y squared equals eight x) epulanini lezixhumanisi. Vumela i-F ibe yi-focus yale parabola, futhi iphoyinti P(x, y) libe yiphoyinti ku-parabola. Umfundi othile uxazulule inkinga yokuthola onke amaphoyinti P anebanga PF elilingana no-10 njengoba kuboniswe ngezansi. Amayunithi ezixhumanisi wonke ayafana, futhi ubude bubhalwe ngaphandle kwamayunithi.
y-m-71-01.thinking.1: Ukuthola ukuthi mangaki amaphoyinti anelisa isimo
y-m-71-01.thinking.2: Ukwahlulela ukuthi isixazululo siyakhona yini ngebanga lamanani angenzeka
y-m-71-01.prereq.0: Umcabango: lo msebenzi ubekelwe izinga eliphakeme lesikole esiphakeme, ukuxazululwa ngemva kokufunda kakade isifundo esikhethiwe 'Geometry' (izingxenye zekoni, ama-vector epulani, izimo ezikhonkolo nezixhumanisi zesikhala); 'H3' ilebula yobunzima kuphela yalesi sethi sokukhiqiza futhi ayisho ukuthi isifundo sabelwe ibanga elithile. Incazelo ye-parabola (i-focus ne-directrix), i-focus ne-directrix yohlobo lwe-y²=4px, ifomula yebanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili
y-m-71-01.s.s1.hint.0: Faka isisho somugqa ngamunye ngqo emugqeni olandelayo, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi inani lamacala lehlisiwe yini uma usuka emugqeni wangaphambilini uya kolandelayo.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala wonke amanani u-y angawathatha uma u-x = 8 efakwa esibalweni se-parabola.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.0: Ohlotsheni lwe-y² = 4px, 4p = 8, ngakho p = 2, i-focus F ngu-(2, 0), futhi i-directrix ngu-x = −2.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.1: Kuphoyinti P(x, y) ku-parabola, PF ilingana nebanga kusuka ku-P liye ku-directrix, ngakho PF = x + 2.
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.3: y² = 8 · 8 = 64, ngakho y = 8, futhi iphoyinti kuphela elanelisa isimo ngu-P(8, 8).
y-m-71-01.s.s1.line.4: Ngakho iphoyinti P elinelisa PF = 10 ngu-(8, 8).
y-m-71-01.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 1 kuya ku-3 ilungile. Emugqeni 4, uma y² = 64 khona y = 8 noma y = −8. I-parabola ine-symmetry nge-x-axis, ngakho womabili amaphoyinti (8, 8) no-(8, −8) anelisa isimo. Umugqa 5 nje ufake ukushiywa komugqa 4.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.prompt: Faka amaphoyinti angu-2 ahlukene P(x, y) ku-parabola anezixhumanisi eziyizinombolo eziphelele anelisa PF = 10. (I-focus F ngu-(2, 0).)
y-m-71-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale ubudlelwano phakathi kuka-x no-y njengesibalo usebenzisa isimo sokuthi iphoyinti liku-parabola.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha u-x oyedwa, uhlole ukuthi u-y uphuma yinombolo eqondile yini, bese ubala ngqo ibanga elisuka kuleli phoyinti liya ku-F.
y-m-71-01.s.s2.explain: Amaphoyinti kuphela anelisa yomibili imibandela ngu-(8, 8) no-(8, −8). x imiswe ibe yinani elilodwa futhi uphawu luka-y kuphela lunamathuba amabili.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.prompt: Mangaki amaphoyinti P epharabolani efanayo ane-PF = 1?
y-m-71-01.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala u-PF njengesisho ku-x bese uhlola ububanzi bamanani u-x angawathatha kumaphoyinti epharabolani.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.hint.1: Bala ngqo ibanga elisuka ku-vertex O(0, 0) kuya ku-F.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.a: Uma ubala u-PF ku-vertex ngqo, akungu-1. Uqagele iphoyinti eliseduze kakhulu ngaphandle kokubala.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.b: Uthwale isiphetho 'amaphoyinti amabili alinganayo' esinyathelweni sangaphambilini njengoba sinjalo. Kumele uqale uhlole ukuthi inani lika-x liyenzeka yini.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.c: Isisho PF = x + 2 sikuvumela ukuthi unqume ububanzi bamanani angenzeka. Lesi akusona isimo sokungabi nalwazi olwanele.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.r.d: x + 2 iba ngu-2 enanini elincane kakhulu u-x angalithatha. Lesi yisahlulelo esihlolile ububanzi obungenzeka bebanga.
y-m-71-01.s.s3.explain: PF = x + 2, futhi epharabolani x ≥ 0, ngakho PF ≥ 2. Ukuze PF = 1 sidinga x = −1, kodwa khona-ke y² = −8 futhi akukho y yangempela. Umbandela webanga ungase ungabi nasixazululo nhlobo.

y-m-71-02.title: Ingabe amaphoyinti anesamba esingashintshi samabanga ahlala eyi-ellipse?
y-m-71-02.topic: Incazelo ye-ellipse (isamba samabanga ayo emaphoyinteni amabili)
y-m-71-02.goal: Thola umbandela odingekayo ukuze isethi yamaphoyinti anesamba esingashintshi samabanga emaphoyinteni amabili ibe yi-ellipse, bese usho ukuthi yisiphi isibalo esiphumayo uma umbandela ulahlekile noma usemngceleni.
y-m-71-02.material: Endizeni yokuqondanisa kunamaphoyinti amabili F(−4, 0) no-F'(4, 0) (ifundwa: F no-F prime). Ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili lingu-8. Iphoyinti P(x, y) lihamba ukuze PF + PF' = s. Lapha s i-constant enhle, futhi ubude bubhalwa ngaphandle kwamayunithi.
y-m-71-02.prereq.0: Umcabango: lo msebenzi usethwe ezingeni eliphakeme lesikole esiphakeme, ukuxazululwa ngemva kokufunda inkambo yokukhetha 'Geometry' (ama-conic sections, ama-vector endiza, izinto eziqinile nokuqondanisa komkhathi); 'H3' iwuphawu lobunzima kuphela kwalesi sabelo sokukhiqiza futhi ayisho ukuthi inkambo yabelwe ebangeni elithile. Incazelo nesimo esijwayelekile se-ellipse, ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili, ubudlelwano phakathi kobude bezinhlangothi ezintathu zikanxantathu
y-m-71-02.s.s1.prompt: Ngaphandle kokwazi inani lika-s, singasho yini ukuthi isibalo esidwetshwe iphoyinti P i-ellipse?
y-m-71-02.s.s1.hint.0: Faka amanani ambalwa ku-s bese usebenza ukuthi iphoyinti P elinjalo likhona nhlobo yini.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi yibuphi ubudlelwano obukhona phakathi kobude bezinhlangothi ezintathu uma amaphoyinti P, F no-F' ehlanganiswa ukwenza unxantathu.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.a: Asikwazi ukusho. Uma s ingu-8 noma ngaphansi, akuyona i-ellipse
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.a: Ukhombise ukuthi, ngaphezu kwencazelo, s kumele iqhathaniswe nebanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.b: Singasho. Inqobo nje uma isamba singashintshi, ihlala iyi-ellipse
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.b: Ukhumbule incazelo kuphela kuze kube 'isamba asishintshi'. Ingabe usuke waqhathanisa usayizi wesamba nebanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili?
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.c: Asikwazi ukusho. Kunqunywa izindawo zamaphoyinti amabili kuphela
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.c: s i-constant emisiwe futhi ithinta isimo. Hlola ukuthi kushintsha ini uma ushintsha u-s.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.o.d: Singasho. Noma s iyini inombolo enhle, P iyakhona
y-m-71-02.s.s1.r.d: Uthathe 'P iyakhona' no-'iyi-ellipse' njengento efanayo. Ngisho noma ikhona, isimo singase singabi yi-ellipse.
y-m-71-02.s.s1.explain: PF + PF' ≥ FF' = 8, ngakho uma s < 8 akukho phoyinti P elinjalo, futhi uma s = 8 amaphoyinti asesigabeni i-FF'. Iyi-ellipse kuphela uma s > 8. Ngakho kudingeka ulwazi olwengeziwe ngo-s.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.prompt: Uma s = 10, faka amaphoyinti ama-2 ahlukene P(x, y) anokuqondanisa kwezinombolo eziphelele anelisa PF + PF' = 10.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokukhetha amaphoyinti ezi-axis bese ubala u-PF no-PF' kwelinye ngalinye.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.hint.1: Uma isamba samabanga amabili eliphoyinti olikhethile likhulu kuno-10, hambisa iphoyinti eduze nama-focus amabili; uma lincane, lisuse kude nakakhulu.
y-m-71-02.s.s2.explain: Amaphoyinti kuphela anokuqondanisa kwezinombolo eziphelele angamaphoyinti amane (5, 0), (−5, 0), (0, 3) no-(0, −3). Ukuqala ezi-axis kukuvumela ukuthi wengeze amabanga ngokushesha. Kunamaphoyinti amaningi kakhulu e-ellipse angewona izinombolo eziphelele.
y-m-71-02.s.s3.prompt: Uma s = 8, yisiphi isibalo wonke amaphoyinti P anelisa PF + PF' = 8 alenzayo?
y-m-71-02.s.s3.hint.0: Bala PF + PF' endaweni esesigabeni i-FF' (isibonelo i-origin).
y-m-71-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bala isamba endaweni engasesigabeni (isibonelo (0, 1)) bese uliqhathanisa no-8.
y-m-71-02.s.s3.r.a: Uma isamba singu-8, silingana nebanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili. Sebenza ukuthi isamba kumele sibe sikhulu kunalokho yini ukuze kube yi-ellipse.
y-m-71-02.s.s3.r.b: Bala isamba endaweni enye esesigabeni. Isamba siyini endaweni ephakathi O(0, 0)?
y-m-71-02.s.s3.r.c: Uma u-P esesigabeni, PF + PF' ngu-8 ngqo. Uhlukanise icala lomngcele.
y-m-71-02.s.s3.r.d: Bala isamba ngqo endaweni eyodwa esesigabeni. Awuzange uhlole ukuthi ngempela awekho amaphoyinti.
y-m-71-02.s.s3.explain: Uma u-P esesigabeni i-FF', khona-ke PF + PF' = 8, futhi uma engasesigabeni, isamba sikhulu kuno-8 ngenxa yobudlelwano phakathi kobude bezinhlangothi zikanxantathu. Ngakho isibalo uma s = 8 siyisigaba.

y-m-71-03.title: Uma ihlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela, iyi-tangent?
y-m-71-03.goal: Zithole wena icala lapho isiphetho esijwayelekile 'ilayini elihlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela liyi-tangent' siphuka khona ku-hyperbola, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani, uxhumanise nama-asymptote.
y-m-71-03.material: Cabanga nge-hyperbola H: x²/9 − y²/16 = 1 (ifundwa: x squared phezu kuka-9 kususwe y squared phezu kuka-16 kulingana no-1). Ama-asymptote e-H angu-y = (4/3)x no-y = −(4/3)x. Amalayini abhalwa ngesimo px + qy = r (p, q no-r kuyizinombolo eziphelele futhi p no-q akulona bobabili u-0). Umfundi uthe, 'Kwi-ellipse, ilayini elihlangana nayo endaweni eyodwa kuphela liyi-tangent. Ngakho ku-H nakho, ilayini elihlangana nayo endaweni eyodwa kuphela kumele libe yi-tangent.'
y-m-71-03.thinking.0: Ukuhlonza imibandela yesibonelo esiphikisayo kwisiphetho esijwayelekile
y-m-71-03.thinking.2: Ukuchaza umehluko phakathi kwe-tangent nelayini elihlangana endaweni eyodwa
y-m-71-03.prereq.0: Umcabango: lo msebenzi usethwe ezingeni eliphakeme lesikole esiphakeme, ukuxazululwa ngemva kokufunda inkambo yokukhetha 'Geometry' (ama-conic sections, ama-vector endiza, izinto eziqinile nokuqondanisa komkhathi); 'H3' iwuphawu lobunzima kuphela kwalesi sabelo sokukhiqiza futhi ayisho ukuthi inkambo yabelwe ebangeni elithile. Isimo esijwayelekile nama-asymptote e-hyperbola, incazelo ye-discriminant lapho ilayini ne-conic kuhlanganiswa
y-m-71-03.s.s1.prompt: Yiluphi uhlobo lwelayini okufanele ulifune ukuhlola ukuthi isitatimende salo mfundi sihlala silungile na ku-H?
y-m-71-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala isimangalo sihlukaniswe ube 'uma umbandela A khona-ke isiphetho B'. A no-B yini?
y-m-71-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi isimangalo siyaphuka yini uma kukhona ngisho nesibonelo esisodwa.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.o.a: Elinye ilayini elihlangana no-H emaphoyinteni amabili ahlukile
y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.a: Isimangalo simayelana namalayini ahlangana 'endaweni eyodwa kuphela'. Ilayini elihlangana emaphoyinteni amabili alisona into yesimangalo.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.o.b: Ilayini elingewona i-tangent elihlangana no-H endaweni eyodwa kuphela
y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.b: Uzamile ukuthola ilayini elinelisa umbandela wokuqala 'ihlangana endaweni eyodwa' kodwa liphula umbandela wesibili 'iyi-tangent'.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.c: I-tangent ehlangana endaweni eyodwa isibonelo esivumelana nesimangalo. Ukuqoqa izibonelo eziningi ezinjalo akukwazi ukukutshela ukuthi isimangalo asilungile.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.r.d: Ilayini elingahlangani no-H alinelisi umbandela wesimangalo (ukuhlangana endaweni eyodwa) ngokuqala.
y-m-71-03.s.s1.explain: Ukukhombisa ukuthi 'uma A khona-ke B' akulungile, udinga isibonelo esinelisa u-A kodwa asinelisi u-B. Lapha u-A ngu-'ihlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela' futhi u-B ngu-'iyi-tangent'.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.prompt: Phakathi kwamalayini px + qy = r, faka amalayini ama-2 ahlukene ahlangana no-H endaweni eyodwa ngqo kodwa angewona ama-tangent. (|p|, |q| ≤ 20, |r| ≤ 100. Ilayini elifanayo elibhalwe ngezinombolo eziphelele ezilinganayo libalwa njengelayini elilodwa.)
y-m-71-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala kabusha ilayini ngesimo y = mx + k bese ulifaka esibalweni sika-H; bala ukuthi likhona yini m eyenza i-coefficient ye-x² esishweni ku-x ilingane no-0.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa lowo m ne-slope yama-asymptote e-H, bese ubhala i-slope njengesilinganiso sika-p no-q ukuze p no-q babe yizinombolo eziphelele.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Uma p no-q bobabili bengu-0, akuyona ilayini.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Gcina p no-q bengu-20 noma ngaphansi kanye no-r engu-100 noma ngaphansi ngevelu eliphelele.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Liyilayini elihlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela (umbandela we-slope).
y-m-71-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Lelayini alisiyo uhlobo oluhlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela (noma iyi-tangent).
y-m-71-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Alidluli ku-origin, ngakho ngempela lihlangana no-H.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Uma r = 0, kuyi-asymptote ngokwayo futhi ayihlangani no-H.
y-m-71-03.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo: 4x + 3y = 6 ihlangana no-H endaweni eyodwa kuphela kodwa akuyona i-tangent. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi i-slope yalelilayini ifana ne-slope ye-asymptote u-y = −(4/3)x. 5x + 3y = 9 noma x = 3 zihlangana endaweni eyodwa futhi ziyi-tangent, ngakho azisizo izibonelo eziphikisayo.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.prompt: Chaza emishweni emi-2 kuya kwemi-3 ukuthi kungani ilayini olikhethile lingeyona i-tangent nakuba lihlangana no-H endaweni eyodwa kuphela, usebenzisa isibalo selayini lakho noma i-asymptote ne-slope.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala emshweni owodwa ukuthi yiliphi inani esibalweni selayini elifana nelika-asymptote.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.hint.1: Engeza umugqa owodwa ngokuthi idigri yesisho ku-x ishintsha kanjani.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe incazelo yami ifaka isibalo noma i-slope yelayini engilikhethile?
y-m-71-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngihlukanise ngamazwi ami ukuthi 'ihlangana endaweni eyodwa' no-'iyi-tangent' akufani?
y-m-71-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ngicabange ukuthi uhlelo lwezibalo ngabe lwahluka kanjani uma lwaluyi-tangent?
y-m-71-03.s.s3.model.0: Ilayini 4x + 3y = 6 lifana ne-slope ye-asymptote u-y = −(4/3)x, ngakho lifana. Uma lifakwa, i-coefficient ye-x² iyanyamalala futhi iba yisibalo esilayini esinesixazululo esisodwa kuphela, ngakho ihlangana endaweni eyodwa kuphela, kodwa akusona isibalo se-quadratic esinempande ephindwe kabili, ngakho akuyona i-tangent.
y-m-71-03.s.s3.model.1: Ilayini elifana ne-asymptote lihlangana no-H endaweni eyodwa, kodwa lihlukile ku-tangent, i-discriminant yayo engu-0. I-tangent ihlangana no-H endaweni yokuthinta futhi ihlala ohlangothini olulodwa legophe, kuyilapho lelilayini lidlula ngegatsha elilodwa le-H.

y-m-71-06.title: Mangaki amaphoyinti anelisa izimo zamabanga alinganayo?
y-m-71-06.topic: Amabanga asuka ephoyintini aya kuma-axis nezindiza endaweni yezixhumanisi
y-m-71-06.goal: Hlukanisa ibanga eliya ku-axis nebanga eliya endizeni yokuxhumanisa endaweni yezixhumanisi, bese uklama amaphoyinti anelisa zombili izimo zebanga ngesikhathi esisodwa.
y-m-71-06.material: Endaweni yezixhumanisi i-x-axis, i-y-axis ne-z-axis zimi nkabi komunye nomunye, futhi indiza ye-xy iyindiza u-z = 0. Kukhona iphoyinti u-P(3, 4, 12). 'Ibanga elisuka ephoyintini liye ku-axis yokuxhumanisa' bubude bomugqa omi nkabi osuka ephoyintini uye ku-axis, futhi 'ibanga elisuka ephoyintini liye endizeni yokuxhumanisa' bubude bomugqa omi nkabi oya endizeni. Ubude bubhalwa ngaphandle kwezinyunithi.
y-m-71-06.thinking.0: Ukuhlukanisa ibanga eliya ku-axis nebanga eliya endizeni
y-m-71-06.thinking.1: Ukuklama amaphoyinti anelisa izimo ezimbili ngesikhathi esisodwa
y-m-71-06.thinking.2: Ukuchaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwenani lezimo nezinga lenkululeko
y-m-71-06.prereq.0: Ukucabanga: lo msebenzi usethwe ebangeni eliphezulu lesikole esiphakeme, ukuze uxazululwe ngemuva kokufunda kakade isifundo esikhethwayo se-'Geometry' (izingxenye zekhoni, ama-vector asendizeni, izinto eziqinile nezixhumanisi zendawo); u-'H3' ulebula nje yobunzima kule batch yokukhiqiza futhi akusho ukuthi isifundo sabelwe ibanga elithile. Izixhumanisi zendawo (izixhumanisi zephoyinti), ibanga phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili, incazelo yama-axis okuxhumanisa nezindiza zokuxhumanisa
y-m-71-06.s.s1.prompt: Liyini ibanga elisuka ephoyintini u-P(3, 4, 12) liye ku-z-axis?
y-m-71-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala izixhumanisi zephoyinti ku-z-axis elinoxhumano lwa-z olufanayo no-P.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi ukwehluka phakathi kwalelo phoyinti no-P kuvela engxenyeni yimuphi.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.r.a: Usebenzise iqiniso lokuthi iphoyinti eliseduze kakhulu ku-z-axis ngu-(0, 0, 12) futhi wathola ibanga kusuka ezingxenyeni zika-x no-y kuphela.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.r.b: Uyifunde ngqo i-z-coordinate. I-z-coordinate ihlobene nebanga eliya endizeni ye-xy.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.r.c: Uthole ibanga eliya ekuqaleni. Ukuqala akusilo iphoyinti eliseduze kakhulu ku-axis.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.r.d: Ungeze u-x no-y nje. Ibanga ubude bomugqa omi nkabi, ngakho kumele usebenzise i-Pythagorean theorem.
y-m-71-06.s.s1.explain: Iphoyinti ku-z-axis eliseduze kakhulu no-P ngu-(0, 0, 12), futhi ibanga ngu-√(3² + 4²) = 5. I-z-coordinate 12 yibanga eliya endizeni ye-xy.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.prompt: Faka amaphoyinti angu-4 ahlukile u-Q(x, y, z) anezixhumanisi eziyizinombolo eziphelele anebanga eliya ku-z-axis elingu-5 nebanga eliya endizeni ye-xy elingu-12.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi ibanga elingu-5 eliya ku-z-axis liba yisiphi isisho ku-x no-y, bese uthola amapheya amaningana ezinombolo eziphelele alanelisayo.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi mangaki amanani luka-z avunyelwa ibanga elingu-12 eliya endizeni ye-xy.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Ibanga eliya endizeni ye-xy akulona u-12.
y-m-71-06.s.s2.explain: Kunamapheya angu-12 ezinombolo eziphelele anelisa u-x² + y² = 25, futhi u-z ungu-12 noma u-−12, ngakho kunamaphoyinti angu-24 anezixhumanisi eziyizinombolo eziphelele ngokuphelele. Izimo ezimbili zinamathiselwe ngokuhlukile ezixhumanisini ezihlukile.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.prompt: Chaza, usebenzisa amaphoyinti owenzile njengezibonelo, ukuthi kungani amaphoyinti amaningi kangaka anelisa izimo nakuba zimbili kuphela. Bhala nokuthi indlela yokukhetha u-x no-y yehluke kanjani endleleni yokukhetha u-z.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala ukuthi u-x² + y² = 25 uyiyiphi isethi yamaphoyinti endizeni ye-xy.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi isimo sika-z sivumela amanani amangaki luka-z.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngichazile ngokuhlukile yini isimo esinquma u-x no-y nesimo esinquma u-z?
y-m-71-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngifakile okungenani uxhumano olulodwa lweiphoyinti engilenzile njengesibonelo?
y-m-71-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngicabangile ukuthi kuzoba mangaki amaphoyinti ayengeziwe uma izixhumanisi zazingadingeki zibe yizinombolo eziphelele?
y-m-71-06.s.s3.model.0: Uma ibanga eliya ku-z-axis lingu-5, khona-ke u-x² + y² = 25, ngakho kubhekwe endizeni ye-xy amaphoyinti alele esiyingini esinoradiyasi 5. Kunamaphoyinti amaningi anjalo, njengo-(3, 4) noma u-(4, −3), futhi uma ibanga eliya endizeni ye-xy lingu-12, khona-ke u-z ungu-12 noma u-−12, amacala amabili, ngakho amaphoyinti ayanda.
y-m-71-06.s.s3.model.1: Kufanele silungise amanani amathathu u-x, y no-z, kodwa kunezimo ezimbili kuphela, ngesamba sika-x² no-y² nangenani eliphelele luka-z, ngakho iphoyinti lingahamba ngokukhululeka. Ngaphandle kuka-3² + 4² = 25 kunamaphoyinti anika u-5² + 0² = 25, futhi u-z ungu-12 noma u-−12, ngakho kunamaphoyinti ahlukile angafika ku-24.

y-m-71-05.title: Uma ububanzi bama-coefficient buyashintsha, iphoyinti lidweba sibalo sini?
y-m-71-05.goal: Bikezela ukuthi isibalo esidwetshwe iphoyinti P sishintsha ngemibandela ye-coefficient x no-y ku-OP = x·OA + y·OB, qinisekisa ukuthi isifunda siba isicaba uma ama-vector amabili efana, bese wakha wena amaphoyinti ahambisana nombandela wendawo.
y-m-71-05.material: Vumela u-O abe yi-origin yendiza yokuqondanisa, bese ubhala indawo yephoyinti P njenge-vector OP = x·OA + y·OB (ifundwa: i-vector OP ilingana no-x izikhathi i-vector OA kanye no-y izikhathi i-vector OB). x no-y yizinombolo zangempela futhi imibandela ishintsha esinyathelweni ngasinye. Ubude bubhalwa ngaphandle kwamayunithi.
y-m-71-05.thinking.0: Ukubikezela futhi isibalo uma imibandela ishintsha
y-m-71-05.thinking.1: Ukucabanga ngokuthi ukuthi ama-vector amabili afana yini kuthinta kanjani isifunda
y-m-71-05.prereq.0: Umcabango: lo msebenzi usethwe ezingeni eliphakeme lesikole esiphakeme, ukuxazululwa ngemva kokufunda inkambo yokukhetha 'Geometry' (ama-conic sections, ama-vector endiza, izinto eziqinile nokuqondanisa komkhathi); 'H3' iwuphawu lobunzima kuphela kwalesi sabelo sokukhiqiza futhi ayisho ukuthi inkambo yabelwe ebangeni elithile. Isimo sengxenye yama-vector endiza, ama-scalar multiple nokwengeza, ilayini elidlula emaphoyinteni amabili, indawo ye-parallelogram
y-m-71-05.s.s1.prompt: Imibandela namaphoyinti kuvezwa isinyathelo nesinyathelo. Esinyathelweni ngasinye, bikezela isibalo (noma isifunda) u-P adweba sona.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.hint.0: Esinyathelweni ngasinye, khetha amapheya amabili noma amathathu (x, y) anelisa imibandela bese ubala ukuqondanisa kuka-P ngqo.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.hint.1: Esinyathelweni 3, qhathanisa izingxenye ukubona ukuthi ubudlelwano obunjani bukhona phakathi kuka-OA no-OB.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.info: A(2, 0), B(0, 2), futhi x no-y zonke zinezinombolo zangempela ezanelisa x + y = 1.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.after: U-P = (2x, 2y) no-x + y = 1, ngakho amaphoyinti asemgqeni u-x + y = 2. U-x no-y bangaba negethivu, ngakho kungumugqa wonke u-AB.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ucabange nangokuthi u-x no-y bangaba negethivu.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ucabange kuphela icala lapho u-x no-y bengu-0 noma ngaphezulu. Isimo asinalo umkhawulo ngezimpawu.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: U-x + y = 1 i-equation eyodwa, ngakho ayikwazi ukugcwalisa ingxenye enkulu yendiza. Sebenza ukuthi yimingaki imizamo yenkululeko i-equation esala nayo.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Engeza esinye isimo kuma-A no-B afanayo. U-x + y = 1 no-x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Iphoyinti elinjengo-x = 2, y = −1 lishiywa ngoba liphula u-y ≥ 0. Amaphoyinti asele yilawo anokuthi u-x no-y okungenani u-0 nesamba 1, okungukuthi, ingxenye u-AB. Kulungile ukuncipha kwesibikezelo sesinyathelo esedlule ukuze sifane nesimo.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Awuhlolanga ukuthi yimaphi amaphoyinti asuswa yisimo esisha. U-y uyini uma u-x = 2?
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uhlulele ukuthi kusala kuphela amacala lapho ama-coefficient engeyona negethivu, kushiye kuphela ingxenye phakathi kuka-A no-B.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Hlola ukuthi amaphoyinti lapho u-x ephakathi kuka-0 no-1 nawo anelisa yini isimo.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Shintsha ama-vector abe u-A(2, 1) no-B(4, 2), futhi isimo singu-0 ≤ x ≤ 1, 0 ≤ y ≤ 1. (Akunaso isimo sika-x + y = 1.)
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yini indawo yesifunda u-P ahamba kuso?
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.after: U-OB = 2·OA, ngakho u-P = (x + 2y)·OA. U-x + 2y uguquguquka ukusuka ku-0 kuya ku-3, ngakho isifunda singumugqa osuka ekuqaleni uye ku-(6, 3), futhi indawo yaso ingu-0. Uma ama-vector ehambisana, i-parallelogram iba yisicaba.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ubone ukuthi u-B = 2A, ngakho ama-vector amabili anesiqondiso esifanayo.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uthathe i-rectangle ngama-vector amabili emi nkabi. Awuhlolanga i-engeli phakathi kwama-vector amabili.
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 4 (umkhiqizo wezingxenye zokuqala 2 nezingxenye zesibili 2 zama-vector amabili)
y-m-71-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uphindaphinde ezinye izingxenye kuphela. Indawo ye-parallelogram inqunywa inani elenziwe yiziqondiso zezinhlangothi ezimbili.

y-m-71-05.s.s3.r.d: Uqonde ukuthi yiyiphi ingxenye enquma indawo ngokwesisekelo nokuphakama komumo.
y-m-71-05.s.s3.explain: U-OA useku-x-axis, ngakho isisekelo singu-3 futhi ukuphakama kuyibanga elingu-|b2| elisuka ku-B liya ku-x-axis. Ukushintsha u-b1 kuvusa u-B ngokuhambisana ne-x-axis, ngakho ukuphakama akushintshi.

y-m-71-07.title: Uma umugqa umi nkabi emigqeni emibili, ingabe umi nkabi nasendizeni futhi?
y-m-71-07.goal: Thola isimo esilahlekile esahlulelweni esithi 'uma umugqa umi nkabi emigqeni emibili endizeni, umi nkabi nakuleyo ndiza', bese wakha ngezixhumanisi isibonelo esiphikisayo lapho isimo singekho.
y-m-71-07.material: Endaweni yezixhumanisi indiza ye-xy u-α iyindiza u-z = 0. Umugqa u-m1 yi-x-axis ene-direction vector (1, 0, 0), futhi umugqa u-m2 ngumugqa odlula ephoyintini (0, 1, 0) ohambisana ne-x-axis ene-direction vector (2, 0, 0). Kokubili imigqa isendizeni u-α. Ake i-direction vector yomugqa u-l ibe ngu-d = (d1, d2, d3) (hhayi i-zero vector), futhi umfundi wawuxazulula ngokuthi, 'U-l umi nkabi kokubili ku-m1 no-m2, ngakho umi nkabi no-α.'
y-m-71-07.thinking.1: Ukwenza isibonelo esanelisa izimo kodwa esinesiphetho esiphosile
y-m-71-07.prereq.0: Ukucabanga: lo msebenzi usethwe ebangeni eliphezulu lesikole esiphakeme, ukuze uxazululwe ngemuva kokufunda kakade isifundo esikhethwayo se-'Geometry' (izingxenye zekhoni, ama-vector asendizeni, izinto eziqinile nezixhumanisi zendawo); u-'H3' ulebula nje yobunzima kule batch yokukhiqiza futhi akusho ukuthi isifundo sabelwe ibanga elithile. Uhlobo lwezingxenye nedot product yama-vector ezixhumanisini zendawo, ukuma nkabi nokuhambisana kwemigqa emibili, incazelo yomugqa omi nkabi endizeni
y-m-71-07.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa esixazululweni somfundi lapho ukuthethelela kungenele khona.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ama-equation avela emgqeni 2 nomugqa 3 eceleni komunye bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ayilwazi oluhlukile yini.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi u-d = (0, 1, 0) uyanelisa yini umugqa 2 nomugqa 3 nokuthi lowo mugqa umi nkabi no-α yini.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.0: Ake i-direction vector yomugqa u-l ibe ngu-d = (d1, d2, d3).
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.1: Umi nkabi ne-direction vector (1, 0, 0) luka-m1, ngakho u-d1 = 0.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.2: Umi nkabi nakuyo i-direction vector (2, 0, 0) luka-m2, ngakho u-2 · d1 = 0.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.3: Uma umugqa umi nkabi emigqeni emibili endizeni, umi nkabi nakuleyo ndiza, ngakho u-l ⟂ α.
y-m-71-07.s.s1.line.4: Ngakho u-d kumele abe nefomu elingu-(0, 0, d3).
y-m-71-07.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 2 no-3 ilungile, kodwa umugqa 3 uyi-equation efanayo nomugqa 2 (d1 = 0). Umugqa 4 ushiwo ngaphandle kwesimo sawo, into esebenza kuphela uma imigqa emibili endizeni ingahambisani. Ngakho umugqa 5 nawo awuqinisekisiwe.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.prompt: Faka ama-direction vector angu-3 anezingxenye eziyizinombolo eziphelele, anezeqondiso ezihlukile, emigqa u-l lapho u-d emi nkabi kuwo womabili ama-direction vector luka-m1 no-m2 kodwa u-l engami nkabi no-α. (|d2|, |d3| ≤ 5. Isiqondiso esifanayo sibalwa njengesisodwa.)
y-m-71-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala izimo zokuma nkabi no-m1 no-m2 njengama-equation ezingxenyeni bese uhlola ukuthi iyiphi ingxenye luka-d elungisiwe.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ukuthi u-d kumele abe nobudlelwano obuthini no-(0, 0, 1) ukuze ame nkabi no-α, bese ukhetha izingxenye ezephula lobo budlelwano.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Uma u-d enefomu elingu-(0, 0, d3), umi nkabi no-α, ngakho akusona isibonelo esiphikisayo.
y-m-71-07.s.s2.explain: U-d = (0, 1, 0), (0, 1, 1), (0, 1, 2) bonke banoku-d1 = 0 ngakho bami nkabi no-m1 no-m2, kodwa abahambisani no-(0, 0, 1), ngakho abami nkabi no-α. Njengoba u-m1 no-m2 behambisana, ulwazi olufanayo lusetshenziswe kabili.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.prompt: Ukuze uphethe ngo-l ⟂ α, yiluphi ulwazi okufanele lwengezwe kulolo olungenhla?
y-m-71-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala, ekhethweni ngalinye, ukuthi linika i-equation entsha ezingxenyeni zika-d yini.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi i-equation entsha ilulwazi olufanayo no-d1 = 0 noma ulwazi olwehlukile.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.o.a: Umi nkabi nakkomunye umugqa ku-α ohambisana ne-x-axis
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.a: Umugqa onesiqondiso esifanayo no-m1 no-m2 awunikezi i-equation entsha. Qhathanisa ukuthi uphethe ulwazi olufanayo nemigqa emibili edlule yini.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.b: Indawo yephoyinti ayiguquli i-equation ye-direction vector. Udinga ulwazi mayelana nesiqondiso, hhayi mayelana nephoyinti adlula kulo.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.o.c: Umi nkabi nakumugqa ku-α ongahambisani ne-x-axis
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.c: Uqonde ukuthi udinga ulwazi mayelana nomugqa onesiqondiso esihlukile endizeni. Imigqa emibili engahambisani endizeni efanayo ihlangana ephoyintini elilodwa.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.r.d: Ukuba nephoyinti lokuhlangana kungulwazi mayelana nendawo. Akunikezi i-equation entsha mayelana nesiqondiso.
y-m-71-07.s.s3.explain: Uma emi nkabi emigqeni emibili engahambisani endizeni, umi nkabi nakuleyo ndiza. Isibonelo, uma emi nkabi nakusiqondiso se-y-axis (0, 1, 0), khona-ke u-d2 = 0 futhi u-d = (0, 0, d3).

y-m-71-09.title: Uma kuphrojektwa, indawo iyizikhathi ezingu-cosθ noma ezingu-cos²θ?
y-m-71-09.goal: Hlola eyodwa yamamodeli amabili ngezinombolo kusimo esiqondile, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani isizathu esithi 'zonke izinhlangothi ziyancipha' siphutha ngokuhlukanisa izinhlangothi ezihambisana nomugqa lapho izindiza ezimbili zihlangana khona nalezo eziqonde kuwo.
y-m-71-09.material: Kuma-coordinate esikhala, unxantathu ABC unamakhona A(0, 0, 0), B(4, 0, 0), C(0, 4, 4). I-engeli θ phakathi kwendiza yalo nxantathu ne-xy-plane ingu-45°, futhi cos45° ≈ 0.707. Ithunzi (i-orthogonal projection) lalo nxantathu elehliswe ngokuqonde ku-xy-plane unxantathu onamakhona A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C'(0, 4). UJihu uthe, 'Ubude buncipha buye ku-cosθ izikhathi, ngakho bobabili ububanzi nokuphakama kuyancipha, futhi indawo iba izikhathi ezingu-cos²θ,' futhi uSeoa uthe, 'Indawo iba izikhathi ezingu-cosθ.' Ubude bubhalwa ngaphandle kwamayunithi.
y-m-71-09.prereq.0: Isiqagelo: lo msebenzi usethwe ezingeni eliphezulu lesikole samabanga aphezulu, ukuxazululwa ngemva kokufunda kakade isifundo sokukhetha 'Geometry' (ama-conic section, ama-vector endiza, izimo eziqinile nama-coordinate esikhala); 'H3' ilebuli yobunzima kuphela yale nqwaba yokukhiqiza futhi ayisho ukuthi isifundo sinikezwa ibanga elithile. Ama-coordinate esikhala, i-engeli phakathi kwezindiza ezimbili, incazelo ye-orthogonal projection nemibono eyisisekelo yobude nendawo ephrojektiwe
y-m-71-09.s.s1.prompt: Indawo yonxantathu ABC ingu-8√2 ≈ 11.31 futhi indawo ye-projection ingu-8. Lesi sibonelo esisodwa singasitshela ini ngezitatimende ezimbili?
